evidence.title: shadcn/ui components with variables & Tailwind classes - Updated September 2026 | Figma

name: shadcn/ui components with variables & Tailwind classes
summary: Figma library of shadcn/ui components built on variables and Tailwind classes, with dark and light mode and Radix colors.
description: A Figma recreation of the shadcn/ui components using token-based variables, Tailwind classes and Radix color scales, so themes can be swapped without touching individual components. Dark and light mode are both included, and a companion shadcn create plugin swaps themes, icons, radius and fonts across the whole file.
contains: token-based variables; swap themes without editing components
built on Tailwind classes and Radix color scales
companion shadcn create plugin swaps themes, icons, radius, fonts
